title: Quantifying Trait-State Hierarchy in EEG Foundation Model and Signal Processing Embeddings
abstract: arXiv:2611.05652v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) measures brain activity through recording electrical potentials of the scalp. EEG recordings capture two distinct sets of characteristics in the signal: (1) \emph{Traits} -- information that remains relatively constant over the course of a recording session, such as subject identity, age, and sex; (2) \emph{States} -- signatures that encode responses to external stimuli, including visual, auditory, and motor information. There is limited understanding of how different EEG modeling features (signal processing and foundation models) encode state and trait characteristics. In this work, we quantify state- and trait-level features captured by EEG embeddings using a hierarchy metric and kNN purity on Brain-Computer Interface dataset trials, and find that a majority of EEG features form a macro-trait hierarchy (embeddings form trait-level clusters with micro-states within). translated_title: 量化脑电图（EEG）基础模型与信号处理嵌入中的特质-状态层次结构
translated_abstract: 脑电图（EEG）通过记录头皮上的电位来测量大脑活动。EEG记录捕捉信号中两组不同的特征：（1）特质——在一次记录过程中保持相对恒定的信息，例如受试者身份、年龄和性别；（2）状态——编码对外部刺激响应的特征，包括视觉、听觉和运动信息。目前，人们对不同的EEG建模特征（信号处理方法与基础模型）如何编码状态和特质特征的理解仍然有限。在这项工作中，我们使用层次结构度量指标和kNN纯度，在脑机接口（BCI）数据集试验上量化EEG嵌入所捕获的状态级和特质级特征，并发现大多数EEG特征形成了宏观特质层次结构（即嵌入形成特质级聚类，其内部包含微观状态）。我们的线性探测结果表明……
tldr: 该论文提出用层次结构度量和kNN纯度量化EEG嵌入中特质与状态信息的编码方式，发现大多数EEG特征呈现“宏观特质聚类、微观状态嵌套其中”的层次结构。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies trait- and state-level information encoded in EEG embeddings from foundation models and signal processing methods using a hierarchy metric and kNN purity, finding that most EEG features form a macro-trait hierarchy with micro-states nested within trait-level clusters.
